validity.researcher_notes: EXISTENCE/DUPLICATE (the family's central trap, now resolved): Norilsktransgaz's own production page describes the current Messoyakha-Norilsk system as 'trekhnitochnogo ispolneniya' (three-line design), which in isolation could be misread as meaning only 3 lines EVER existed (raising a phantom/duplicate concern for one of GEM's 4 recorded strings). This is RESOLVED: the 2021 ttelegraf.ru profile explicitly names the three CURRENTLY active lines as 'GAZ-2, GAZ-3 i GAZ-4' and the 2020 gazetazp.ru profile independently names ongoing investment specifically on 'nitkakh 2, 3, 4' -- both excluding line/string I by number, exactly matching GEM's own classification of P1647 as 'retired' and P5666/P5667/P5668 as 'operating'. The 1979-accident retrospective's 'obe nitki [both lines] burst' additionally confirms at least 2 distinct physical lines existed by 1979. This specific row (String II, GAZ-2) is independently named in the 2021 and 2020 sources -- it is a real, distinct physical line, not a duplicate of any sibling string or of the separate P6683/P6684 (Pelyatka-Messoyakha) upstream feeder corridor. CLASSIFICATION: correctly a transmission trunk gas pipeline (magistralnyy gazoprovod), not a gathering/process line. SPEC CONCERN: LengthKnown=263.00km is identical across P1647/P5666/P5667/P5668; only P1647's figure is independently sourced (Gazprom Proektirovanie encyclopedia, specific to the first line's 1969 commissioning), and this row's value was copied by analogy per the original researcher's note on P1647 ('NF 8/16/23: Added three more rows for parallel segments'), never independently confirmed. See the Length [ref] fill for detail, including why the operator's system-wide 1202km aggregate cannot substitute as a segment ref. ATTRIBUTION: Operator=Norilsktransgaz JSC is well-supported for this specific line (see Operator fill) and, unlike string I, is not just a legal successor but the entity actively naming and maintaining this line today.

GEM's recorded LengthKnown=263.00km for this row is IDENTICAL to string I's (P1647) sourced figure -- the Gazprom Proektirovanie (VNIPIgazdobycha) engineering encyclopedia's passage giving 263 km is explicitly about the FIRST line, commissioned 1969 ('Gazoprovod Messoyakha - Norilsk protyazhennostyu 263 km i diametrom 720 mm ... v 1969 godu ... sdan v ekspluatatsiyu'). Per the prior researcher's own note on P1647 ('NF 8/16/23: Added three more rows for parallel segments II, III and IV'), this value was copied to this row by analogy (parallel lines along the same corridor presumed to run the same length as string I), not independently sourced for this specific line. The only other length figure found for this corridor is norilsktgaz.ru's own SYSTEM-WIDE aggregate ('Protyazhennost nitok, vkhodyashchikh v sostav magistralnogo gazoprovoda, sostavlyaet 1202 km' -- combining the 2-line Pelyatka-Sev.Soleninskoye-Yuzh.Soleninskoye-Messoyakha section AND the (post-string-I) 3-line Messoyakha-Norilsk section), which per the aggregate-vs-segment rule can never be used as a ref for one segment's own length cell. Leaving UNRESOLVED rather than fabricating support for a plausible-but-unconfirmed carried-over value. Norilsktransgaz's own current production page describes the Messoyakha-Norilsk section of its operated trunk gas pipeline as 'trekhnitochnogo ispolneniya' (three-line design), corroborating the company as operator of this corridor's active lines.

fills.researcher_notes: Two independent sources confirm Norilsktransgaz JSC as operator of this specific line (GAZ-2 / line II): the 2021 ttelegraf.ru profile names it individually within the three-line system the company operates and actively invests in (capital replacement programme running since 2010, formalised 2017), and Norilsktransgaz's own production page confirms the company operates the Messoyakha-Norilsk corridor's three-line (post-string-I-retirement) configuration. Same operator-succession caveat as P1647 applies in principle (Norilsktransgaz JSC formed Nov 2016) but is not a concern here since this line remained/became active well after that date, unlike retired string I.

No source found suggesting this line is idle, decommissioned, or scheduled for retirement. CONFIRM operating, evidence_date 2021 (most recent dated source directly naming this line).
